source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: If two lines are cut by several parallel lines, the segments on one line are proportional to those on the other.
stages.headlineEnglish: If two lines are cut by several parallel lines, the segments on one line are proportional to those on the other.

stages.headline: Example: AB = 2, BC = 3, A₁B₁ = 4 give B₁C₁ = 6.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: AB = 2, BC = 3, A₁B₁ = 4 give B₁C₁ = 6.

stages.headline: Special case — Thales' theorem: equal segments on one line give equal segments on the other.
stages.headlineEnglish: Special case — Thales' theorem: equal segments on one line give equal segments on the other.

stages.headline: AB = 3, BC = 6, A₁B₁ = 2. What is B₁C₁?
